title.zh: 气候韧性验证走廊：普通蓝绿基线与可逆提示增量
title.en: Climate-Resilience Proof Corridor: Ordinary Blue-Green Baseline with Reversible Prompting

purpose: Organize existing blue-green, shade, rest, stormwater, ecological-maintenance, manual-inspection, prompt-comparison, extreme-weather stop, and removable-interface requirements as one readable spatial contract without changing geometry, scene IDs, projects, maturity, rights, approval, or operating status.

inheritance.frontend: Twin-track Jing-Zhang continuous civic track, intermittent proof track, failure siding, and civic timetable
backend: urban-metabolism whole-system accounting and exit destinations
three-carrier failure writeback and active retirement

cohesive_work_packages.name_zh: 小月河气候观察翼概念关系
cohesive_work_packages.spatial_action: Place an optional, removable observation edge beside the ordinary blue-green route while keeping the river/ecological-maintenance side clear.
cohesive_work_packages.non_ai_baseline: Existing ordinary route, shade/rest intent, static notice, staffed or paper contact, and manual inspection remain sufficient without sensors or AI.
cohesive_work_packages.stop_and_exit: Extreme-weather stop, ecological-maintenance conflict, missing human confirmation, or unaccountable equipment destination removes the optional layer and restores the ordinary edge.
cohesive_work_packages.reality_boundary: Concept relationship only; no exact footprint, river setback, hydraulic performance, ownership, approval, or built facility is claimed.

cohesive_work_packages.name_zh: 连续遮阴、无障碍休息与人工巡检
cohesive_work_packages.name_en: Continuous shade, accessible rest, and manual inspection
cohesive_work_packages.spatial_action: Keep one continuous ordinary movement line, reachable rest intent, and a visible manual-inspection path before any proof overlay.
cohesive_work_packages.non_ai_baseline: No account, QR code, screen, sensor, or AI is required to enter, rest, receive a static warning, ask for help, or leave.
cohesive_work_packages.stop_and_exit: Any overlay that narrows the ordinary route, blocks rest, obscures tactile/visual cues, or prevents inspection is removed or not admitted.
cohesive_work_packages.reality_boundary: Continuity, clear width, slope, shade duration, rest-node count, and accessibility compliance require survey and co-testing and remain unknown.

cohesive_work_packages.spatial_action: Draw infiltration/overflow and landscape-water maintenance as a protected clear process zone; temporary equipment stays outside it.
cohesive_work_packages.non_ai_baseline: Landscape and water staff observe, inspect, isolate, and restore the place through ordinary procedures; sensors do not replace professional judgment.
cohesive_work_packages.stop_and_exit: Blocked flow, uncertain hydraulic consequence, maintenance obstruction, or an extreme-weather notice triggers fail-closed removal and ordinary-place recovery.
cohesive_work_packages.reality_boundary: No runoff volume, drainage capacity, recurrence interval, sponge performance, municipal conclusion, or maintenance completion rate is claimed.

cohesive_work_packages.name_zh: 静态非 AI 与 AI 辅助提示同任务对照
cohesive_work_packages.name_en: Same-task static non-AI and AI-assisted prompt comparison
cohesive_work_packages.spatial_action: Both branches publish the same human-confirmed action and lead to the same ordinary route, staffed handoff, stop rule, and exit.
cohesive_work_packages.non_ai_baseline: A high-contrast paper or physical notice is the primary service; the optional assisted branch cannot remove, delay, price-discriminate, or weaken it.
cohesive_work_packages.stop_and_exit: Stale source, disagreement, no staffed confirmation, unavailable energy, or inaccessible output disables the assisted branch while the static notice and safe refusal remain.
cohesive_work_packages.reality_boundary: No warning accuracy, lead time, false-positive rate, false-negative rate, public response, or operating service is claimed.

cohesive_work_packages.spatial_action: An older or reduced-mobility visitor can follow ordinary, optional-assisted, extreme-weather stop, and recovery states without changing task or surrendering rights.
cohesive_work_packages.non_ai_baseline: Physical wayfinding, reachable rest intent, static notice, spoken or paper handoff, and a continuous exit remain the complete primary journey.
cohesive_work_packages.stop_and_exit: Extreme weather stops activities and the optional layer; staff or a safe static notice directs departure, and restart waits for ordinary-path and place-restoration acceptance.
cohesive_work_packages.reality_boundary: No evacuation time, completion rate, wait time, accessibility result, staffing level, or field acceptance is claimed.

cohesive_work_packages.name_zh: 可拆传感器与服务接口退出
cohesive_work_packages.spatial_action: If later approved, a minimum removable mount sits at the service edge with no permanent dependence by the ordinary place or task.
cohesive_work_packages.non_ai_baseline: The climate corridor remains legible and usable after mount, power, network, data, notice, queue, and service layer are absent.
cohesive_work_packages.stop_and_exit: Remove device and fixing, isolate power/network, export/delete data under approved rules, remove signage/queue, repair surfaces, and independently accept ordinary-place recovery.
cohesive_work_packages.reality_boundary: No device, vendor, power, network, lifecycle, removal rate, procurement, installation, or restoration receipt is confirmed.

same_task_prompt_comparison.task: Receive an understandable, human-confirmed climate safety instruction and choose to continue ordinary movement, rest, seek staffed help, or leave.

static_non_ai.entry: high-contrast physical notice on the ordinary route
static_non_ai.inputs: approved public source and manual observation
static_non_ai.decision_owner: future accountable landscape, water, site, or emergency role; not yet assigned
static_non_ai.outputs: plain-language action, source/date, staffed or paper contact, stop/exit instruction
static_non_ai.availability: primary path; independent of account, QR, screen, sensor, model, or network

optional_ai_assisted.entry: separately disclosed optional prompt beside, never instead of, the static notice
optional_ai_assisted.inputs: only future approved minimum data and versioned public sources
optional_ai_assisted.decision_owner: same human owner confirms before public action
optional_ai_assisted.outputs: same action vocabulary, same ordinary route, same handoff, same stop and appeal
optional_ai_assisted.availability: fails closed on stale source, disagreement, missing human confirmation, inaccessible output, power/network loss, or rights breach

same_task_prompt_comparison.parity_rule: The optional branch must not improve access by weakening the primary branch, and a field comparison must disaggregate older, disabled/reduced-mobility, low-digital-literacy, and no-device/no-account users.

vulnerable_group_journey.public_reading: Follow the continuous ordinary blue-green route; recognize high-contrast physical cues; pause at a reachable-rest intent point; request spoken or paper help; leave without registration.
vulnerable_group_journey.human_role: future staffed or maintenance contact, unconfirmed

vulnerable_group_journey.public_reading: Read the same static notice first; separately choose or refuse the assisted prompt; receive the same human-confirmed action and retain the same rest, help, appeal, and exit rights.
vulnerable_group_journey.exit: refuse or withdraw immediately and continue through the ordinary route

vulnerable_group_journey.public_reading: Activities and optional equipment stop; a physical notice or staff gives a safe refusal and directs the ordinary exit or sheltered handoff without requiring a device.
vulnerable_group_journey.human_role: future emergency/site role with stop authority, unconfirmed
vulnerable_group_journey.exit: ordinary evacuation or staffed handoff; no proof activity continues

vulnerable_group_journey.public_reading: The place reopens first as an ordinary route after hazards, clear zones, accessible intent, static notice, surfaces, and manual inspection are accepted; the optional layer remains off unless separately reauthorized.
vulnerable_group_journey.exit: ordinary use restored; no automatic G0 or authorization change

seasonal_operation_without_calendar_clai.ordinary_action: inspect shade/rest intent and publish a human-confirmed static notice
seasonal_operation_without_calendar_clai.optional_action: compare a bounded assisted prompt only if approved
seasonal_operation_without_calendar_clai.stop: missing confirmation, inaccessible notice, unsafe heat condition, or ordinary-path loss

seasonal_operation_without_calendar_clai.ordinary_action: keep flow, overflow, inspection, and maintenance access clear
seasonal_operation_without_calendar_clai.optional_action: observe only from a removable service edge if approved
seasonal_operation_without_calendar_clai.stop: extreme weather, uncertain hydraulic effect, blocked process, or maintenance conflict

seasonal_operation_without_calendar_clai.ordinary_action: maintenance has priority; keep equipment and public activity outside the work zone
seasonal_operation_without_calendar_clai.optional_action: none unless maintenance staff explicitly accept a bounded observation
seasonal_operation_without_calendar_clai.stop: any obstruction, ecological harm signal, unavailable accountable staff, or incomplete place recovery

future_measurement_contract.required_denominator: same route, user group, date/time window, weather context, and definition of continuous shade
future_measurement_contract.proof_limit: Green-space area or drawing coverage cannot prove thermal comfort or continuous shade.

future_measurement_contract.required_denominator: defined route and user groups with reach, approach, rest, and departure criteria
future_measurement_contract.proof_limit: A symbol or conceptual node cannot prove accessible use.

future_measurement_contract.required_denominator: approved inspection objects, route, window, exception rule, and accountable role
future_measurement_contract.proof_limit: A route drawn in this contract cannot prove staffing or completed inspection.

future_measurement_contract.required_denominator: event definition, reference source, human confirmation, population, time window, and exclusion rule
future_measurement_contract.proof_limit: A prompt template or synthetic PASS cannot prove warning accuracy.

future_measurement_contract.required_denominator: official facility set, maintenance scope, owner, window, and acceptance rule
future_measurement_contract.proof_limit: No hydraulic, sponge-city, drainage-capacity, or municipal performance conclusion follows from this concept section.

future_measurement_contract.required_denominator: declared trigger, observation source, accountable stop authority, service state, and clock rule
future_measurement_contract.proof_limit: The storyboard defines fields only; no real event or response time exists.

future_measurement_contract.required_denominator: all installed components, fixings, power/network, data, signage, queues, surfaces, and same-task service
future_measurement_contract.proof_limit: A removable-mount drawing cannot prove removability, disposal, or place recovery.
